stories.title: Zinc oxide quantum dots enable faster charge detection, laying groundwork for spin qubits
stories.desc: Researchers at Tohoku University, in collaboration with the National Institute for Materials Science (NIMS) and the University of Tokyo, have taken an important step toward semiconductor quantum computing using zinc oxide (ZnO).

stories.title: 3D light fields push electrons into quantum states previously beyond experimental reach
stories.desc: By superimposing two ultrashort laser pulses that converge from different directions, a team of physicists at the University of Oldenburg has succeeded in generating three-dimensional light fields.

stories.title: After 20 years, jet diffusion wakes detected in quark-gluon plasmas
stories.desc: Boats passing over smooth water form a pair of diffusion wakes behind them veering off at a certain angle. Turbulence occurs along the line directly behind the boat, but the two diffusion waves are at a theoretical angle of 19.5° from the same line, for deep, ideally smooth water.

stories.title: Laser-made muons produce first images of dense objects
stories.desc: Muons are constantly being created as cosmic rays collide with molecules in Earth's upper atmosphere. stories.title: Physicists identify 'octupolar' magnetism, with implications for quantum technologies
stories.desc: Most magnets have two poles: north and south, or positive and negative, in a familiar arrangement called a "dipole." But researchers are increasingly uncovering more complex forms of magnetism.
